package_metadata.name: micro_sam
package_metadata.description:
[![DOC](https://shields.mitmproxy.org/badge/docs-pdoc.dev-brightgreen.svg)](https://computational-cell-analytics.github.io/micro-sam/) [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/micro_sam.svg)](https://pypi.org/project/micro_sam/) [![Conda](https://anaconda.org/conda-forge/micro_sam/badges/version.svg)](https://anaconda.org/conda-forge/micro_sam) [![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/computational-cell-analytics/micro-sam/graph/badge.svg?token=7ETPP5CABP)](https://codecov.io/gh/computational-cell-analytics/micro-sam) [![Image.sc forum][imagesc-img]][imagesc-url] [![DOI](https://img.shields.io/badge/DOI-10.5281%2Fzenodo.7919746-blue.svg)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.7919746) # Segment Anything for Microscopy 2 Tools for segmentation, tracking and classification in microscopy built on [Segment Anything 2 (SAM2)](https://ai.meta.com/sam2/). Segment, track and classify objects in microscopy images interactively with a few clicks, or automatically. We implement a napari plugin for: - interactive and automatic segmentation of 2d images and 3d volumes - interactive and automatic tracking of cells in 2d timeseries - classification of segmented objects, for example into cell types - pixel classification, for example for tissue or region segmentation - batch annotation of all images in a folder with any of these tools This functionality is powered by the `micro-sam2` models, which are trained on microscopy data, and the `micro_sam` python library which enables application to large datasets and finetuning on your data. The functionality of the previous version, based on the original [Segment Anything](https://segment-anything.com/) (SAM1), is still available in the `micro_sam.v1` subpackage and in the `micro_sam v1` command line tools.

Interactive Cell Segmentation in 2D
Interactive Mitochondria Segmentation in volumeEM
Automatic Cell Segmentation in 3D
Interactive Cell Tracking in 2D+T

Pixel Classification in Histopathology
Object Classification with Corrections
Batch Nucleus Classification in Histopathology
If you run into any problems or have questions about our tool, please open an [issue](https://github.com/computational-cell-analytics/micro-sam/issues/new/choose) on GitHub or contact us via [image.sc](https://forum.image.sc/) using the tag `micro-sam`, and tagging [@anwai98](https://forum.image.sc/u/anwai98/summary) and [@constantinpape](https://forum.image.sc/u/constantinpape/summary). You can follow recent updates on `micro_sam` in our [news feed](https://forum.image.sc/t/microsam-news-feed). ## Installation and Usage Please check [the documentation](https://computational-cell-analytics.github.io/micro-sam/) for details on how to install and use `micro_sam`. You can also watch [the quickstart video](https://youtu.be/gcv0fa84mCc), [our virtual I2K workshop video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dxjU4W7bCis&list=PLdA9Vgd1gxTbvxmtk9CASftUOl_XItjDN&index=33) or [all video tutorials](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLwYZXQJ3f36GQPpKCrSbHjGiH39X4XjSO&si=qNbB8IFXqAX33r_Z). The videos show the previous version, so the user interface differs from the current one. `micro_sam` works best on a computer with a GPU. It can be used on a normal laptop with a CPU, but will be slow for applications in 3D or for large images. Note: we are working on improving performance on Macbook with an M-series chip; it will be much faster there soon! ## Contributing We always welcome new contributions! If you just want to suggest a documentation edit, [you can do this directly here, on GitHub][edit-files-on-github]. For more complex changes, see [CONTRIBUTING.md][contributing] or the [contributing guide](https://computational-cell-analytics.github.io/micro-sam/micro_sam.html#contribution-guide) in our documentation for details. The first step is to [discuss your idea in a new issue](https://github.com/computational-cell-analytics/micro-sam/issues/new) with the current developers. Everyone participating in this project is expected to follow our [Code of Conduct][code-of-conduct]. ## Citation If you use this repository in your research, please cite - our [μSAM2 preprint](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.12.766082) (if you use μSAM2) - our [μSAM publication](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-024-02580-4) (μSAM1) - If you use automatic tracking, please also cite [Trackastra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.15700). Other publications relevant for specific aspects: - The [SAM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.02643) and [SAM2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.00714) publications that describe the models we buid on for μSAM1 / μSAM2. - Our publication on the [Automatic Prompt Generation (APG)](https://openreview.net/forum?id=xFO3DFZN45) segmentation mode. - Our publication on interactive object and pixel classification: [μClass](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19802) - Our previous special-purpose models for [histopathology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.00408) and [medical imaging](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11303368). ## Related Projects There is one other napari plugin built around Segment Anything 2: - https://github.com/royerlab/napari-segment-anything-2 (2d and video support) Compared to this plugin we support more applications (2d, 3d, tracking and classification), and provide finetuning methods and finetuned models for microscopy data. [WebKnossos](https://webknossos.org/), [QuPath](https://github.com/ksugar/qupath-extension-sam) and [Fiji](https://github.com/segment-anything-models-java/SAMJ-IJ) also integrate Segment Anything 2 for interactive segmentation, mainly in 2d. ## Release Overview You can find an overview of changes introduced in previous releases [here](https://github.com/computational-cell-analytics/micro-sam/blob/main/RELEASE_OVERVIEW.md).
